abstract: Configure Continue (VS Code, JetBrains, cn CLI) for self-hosted OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic-compatible endpoints (vLLM, llama.cpp, Ollama, LiteLLM, llama-swap). Covers config.yaml models, apiBase rules, secrets in ~/.continue/.env, roles, capabilities, model-name mapping, the Responses API trap, tool-calling and streaming caveats, troubleshooting, a validated template and a read-only probe script.
